regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride is forecast for about 14", 11" of it Sunday. Crested Butte about 7" and Aspen Highlands about 5". The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Telluride Sunday. Winter Storm Watch in effect at Telluride.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek is forecast for about 13", 12" of it Sunday. Taos about 4". The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Taos Sunday and Sunday night. Winter Storm Watch in effect at Wolf Creek.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 7", all of it Sunday. Jackson Hole about 6" and Big Sky about 3". The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Jackson Hole Sunday and Sunday night.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 6", all of it Saturday. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Mammoth Saturday and Saturday night. Winter Weather Advisory in effect at Mammoth.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Alta is forecast for about 6", 5" of it Sunday. Snowbird about 6" and Brighton about 6". The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Alta Sunday and Sunday night.
